RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

Pointing to the panel's gender composition as evidence of discrimination is legally insufficient and will harm your professional standing. A panel's demographic makeup alone does not demonstrate bias.

For a leadership position, client relationships, commercial acumen, and interview performance frequently outweigh additional years of technical design experience. Strong client connections are vital for heading a consultancy group and generating business.

Rather than alleging bias based on the panel, follow up professionally on your written feedback request. Focus on learning which competencies and strategic priorities the firm valued most, which preserves your industry reputation and constructively aids future applications.
